info.name: Adobe Experience Cloud Adobe Analytics 2.0 Activities Reports API
Adobe Analytics Adobe Experience Cloud Retrieve a Report

params.name: companyId
params.description: The global company ID for the Analytics account.

items.docs: Submits a report request to Adobe Analytics and returns the resulting data. The request body defines the report suite, dimensions, metrics, date range, and any segment or filter criteria. Results are returned as a ranked or trended data set in JSON format.
